title: List variant components next to PCB components
summary: Reads the current project variant's component variations and alternate library links, walks the PCB components and matches each one to its variation by SourceUniqueId or designator; a helper creates a NotFitted variant.
phrasings: find which PCB components are not fitted in a variant
match a PCB component to its schematic component
create a project variant from code

commands.name: GetVariantComponent
commands.description: List the current variant's component variations and the board's PCB components

commands.name: AddTestVariant
commands.description: Create a variant with one Not Fitted component and make it current (test setup)
